what_this_is: Settings for carry-connections.mjs, the program on a person's own computer that connects or carries sources only that computer can reach. Each row in `connections` is one service: its vendor (the service-connections descriptor it answers for, which says `carriedBy`), the module and export that carry or connect it, and that module's own settings and words. Adding a service is a row here plus its module; the program itself never names one.
agent_description: The Trillion helper on {computer}: sends and reads messages through the accounts this computer carries ({carried}).
take_gap_ms_why: A store changes several times a second while a file uploads, and each change used to send a take; one take per 5 seconds covers them all, so a message this computer sends waits at most 5 seconds more.

words.not_carried: This computer does not carry {vendor} right now: {why}
words.too_old: This request waited more than {minutes} minutes, so it was not sent; ask again.
words.failed: It did not work on this computer: {error}

words.no_account: No iMessage account is signed in to Messages on this Mac.
words.asking: macOS is asking whether the program running the helper may control Messages. Click Allow on that prompt (or turn it on in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation), and the helper picks it up within a few minutes.
words.automation: macOS did not let the helper control Messages. Turn it on in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation, under the program running the helper, then ask again.
words.unknown_recipient: Messages does not know that phone number or email as an iMessage address.
words.full_disk_access: macOS did not let the helper read your messages. Turn on Full Disk Access for the program running the helper in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access, then ask again.

words.stopped: WhatsApp reading was stopped on this computer. Use resume_carried_service to resume it.
words.not_linked: WhatsApp is not linked on this computer yet. Use connect_carried_service to start pairing and leave the phone code step to the person.
words.phone_needed: Tell me the WhatsApp phone number in international format so I can start pairing.
words.already_linked: WhatsApp is already linked on this computer.
words.logged_out: WhatsApp logged this computer out. Use connect_carried_service to start pairing again.
words.not_open: WhatsApp is not connected on this computer right now.
words.unknown_recipient: That is not a WhatsApp number: give the country code first, digits only.
